claims.claim: Long production history, data and existing seals/fault behaviour support reliable CO2 containment.
claims.assessment: Qualitative site-screening rationale retained. Historical hydrocarbons and low inferred fault transmissibility are not a quantitative CO2 leakage, fracture or permanence model.

claims.claim: 100 realisations/history matching and ten selected members yield a highly accurate storage plan.
claims.assessment: No raw observations, objective, tolerance, observation error, hold-out or posterior weights supplied. Visual fit and selection do not independently calibrate forecast accuracy or confidence.

claims.assessment: Limit formulation is reported but numerical value/reference/control implementation absent. Increasing cumulative curves continue afterward; no zero annual flow inferred.

claims.claim: CO2 migrates toward the structural crest and deeper wells promote residual/dissolution trapping.
claims.assessment: Maps/placement rationale read. PVT, relative permeability/hysteresis, dissolution kinetics and phase/trapping inventories unavailable; no fraction or complete trapping mechanism independently reproduced.

claims.claim: Adding relief wells increases injection by25–30% and delays the pressure threshold.
claims.assessment: Attributed cumulative model result; a normalised B/A index1.25–1.30 is the only quantitative transformation. No absolute baseline, paired member arrays or pressure/timing increment recovered from unscaled plots.

claims.claim: Water extraction improves capacity while avoiding CO2 breakthrough.
claims.assessment: Placement aims to mitigate breakthrough, but extraction/CO2 production limits, breakthrough criteria/times and produced-water handling outputs not disclosed. No one-to-one displaced-volume rule or zero-CO2-production proof.

claims.claim: Simulation confirms injectivity, integrity and technical feasibility.
claims.assessment: The paper provides a proprietary predictive study, not observed injection validation or independent model reproduction. Full numerical cases/constraints/uncertainty and access remain unverified.

claims.claim: This project contributes to national large-scale CCS/carbon-neutrality objectives.
claims.assessment: Strategic recommendation; additional injected volume is not quantified net mitigation. Capture, water-treatment, wells, assets, utilities, legacy production and permanence boundaries require separate inventory.
